faqs.question: What is a word counter?
faqs.answer: A word counter is a digital writing utility that analyzes entered text to calculate the exact number of words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and reading duration in real time.

faqs.question: How does an online word counter work?
faqs.answer: Our online word counter processes your text instantly within your browser using Unicode-aware text segmentation algorithms. As you type or paste content, it identifies word boundaries, sentence terminators, and paragraph line breaks without sending data to any external server.

faqs.question: Is this word counter free?
faqs.answer: Yes, this word counter is 100% free to use with no account registration, trial limits, or hidden fees required.

faqs.question: How are words counted?
faqs.answer: Words are counted based on standard linguistic word boundaries, separating sequences of letters, numbers, and symbols. The tool intelligently handles multiple consecutive spaces, tabs, line breaks, and hyphenated compound words without inflating counts.

faqs.question: Does the word counter count characters?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool simultaneously calculates total characters including spaces as well as characters excluding spaces.

faqs.question: Can I count characters without spaces?
faqs.answer: Yes. The 'Characters (No Spaces)' metric strips out all whitespace characters (spaces, tabs, newlines) and counts only visible letters, digits, and punctuation marks, which is ideal for platforms with strict non-whitespace restrictions.

faqs.question: Does it count sentences and paragraphs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sentences are detected using standard sentence-ending punctuation (. ! ?), while paragraphs are calculated based on non-empty text blocks separated by line breaks.

faqs.question: How is reading time calculated?
faqs.answer: Reading time is estimated using an average adult silent reading benchmark of approximately 200 to 250 words per minute (WPM). The result is clearly marked as an estimate since reading speed varies by subject matter and complexity.

faqs.question: How is speaking time calculated?
faqs.answer: Speaking time is estimated based on an average presentation speaking pace of approximately 130 words per minute, helping public speakers and scriptwriters time their talks.

faqs.question: Can I use this tool for essays and assignments?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Students, researchers, and copywriters frequently use this tool to verify length requirements for college applications, academic essays, research abstracts, and journal submissions.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. All text parsing and counting happens 100% locally on your computer or mobile device. None of your writing is ever transmitted, logged, or stored on our servers.

faqs.question: Is my pasted text transmitted to any external server?
faqs.answer: No. The entire analysis occurs inside your browser's local JavaScript engine. Your draft text is never logged, transmitted, or saved remotely.

faqs.question: Does this tool support non-Latin scripts (Hindi, Japanese, Korean)?
faqs.answer: Yes. The counter implements Unicode character property ranges and CJK character tokenization so Asian characters and scripts are counted accurately.

faqs.question: What is the difference between character count with and without spaces?
faqs.answer: Count with spaces includes blank whitespace and line breaks, which is standard for social media (Twitter/X) and academic assignments. Count without spaces counts only visible glyphs.

Word Counter Online: Accurate Writing Metrics at Your Fingertips

Whether you are drafting a university thesis, polishing an article, or preparing a speech, our word counter online gives you instant clarity over your document's length and rhythm. By simply typing or pasting your draft into the writing area, you receive real-time updates of words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, reading time, and speaking duration.

Unlike desktop word processors that bury character counts behind menu tabs, this online word counter updates continuously as you type. It recognizes international Unicode characters, ensuring smooth operation across languages including English, Hindi, Spanish, and European scripts.

⚡

Real-Time Analysis

Every keystroke and pasted sentence recalculates counts instantly without refreshing the page or interrupting your focus.

🔒

Complete Privacy

All text analysis executes 100% inside your browser. No drafts, essays, or confidential memos are ever uploaded to any server.

⏱️

Reading & Speech Pacing

Plan keynote presentations and script recordings with automated estimates for both silent reading and spoken delivery.

Free Word Counter Tool: Designed for Writers, Students, and Marketers

Our word counter free utility provides a clean, distraction-free environment without annoying popups or subscription paywalls. As a modern word counter tool, it is engineered for high performance: whether you paste a 100-word product description or an entire 50,000-word book manuscript, the counter runs smoothly in local memory.

The built-in case formatting tools let you quickly convert pasted text into sentence case, title case, uppercase, or lowercase with a single click, saving you time during editorial review.

What Does a Word Counter Count?

Effective writing requires understanding multiple dimensions of text volume. This tool computes comprehensive metrics simultaneously:

Words

Identifies discrete linguistic word units separated by whitespace and punctuation, preventing spaces or tabs from being tallied as words.

Characters (With Spaces)

Every letter, number, space, and punctuation mark in the document. Essential for platforms that measure overall byte or character limits.

Characters (Excluding Spaces)

Measures only printable letters, numbers, and symbols. Standard for international academic submissions and translation invoicing.

Sentences

Estimates sentence count using terminal punctuation marks (periods, exclamation marks, and question marks) while ignoring common decimal points.

Paragraphs

Counts distinct blocks of text separated by line breaks. Empty blank lines are automatically excluded from the count.

Reading & Speaking Times

Calculates estimated duration using realistic human reading (~225 WPM) and speech (~130 WPM) speed benchmarks.

How to Use This Word Counter

Using our online counter is fast and straightforward:

Step 1

Type or Paste

Enter or paste your text into the main writing area.

Step 2

Instant Analysis

The tool automatically calculates all metrics as you write.

Step 3

Review Counts

Check words, characters with/without spaces, and paragraphs.

Step 4

Check Pacing

Verify reading duration and speaking time for presentations.

Step 5

Copy or Clear

Copy your text to the clipboard or click Clear to start fresh.

Why Is Word Count Important?

Word count is a universal standard for assessing depth, readability, and compliance across communication channels:

🎓 Academic Essays & Assignments

Schools, colleges, and examination boards assign strict word brackets (e.g. 1,500 words ±10%). Submitting an essay that falls short or exceeds the upper limit often incurs direct grade penalties.

✍️ Blog Posts & Online Articles

Comprehensive editorial guides typically range between 1,200 and 2,500 words to answer user search intent thoroughly while sustaining engagement and organic search ranking.

🎤 Speeches & Video Scripts

Keynote talks, wedding speeches, and YouTube video voiceovers require precise timing. Knowing your word count helps you comfortably meet time slots without rushing or trailing off.

📧 Professional Emails & Executive Summaries

Conciseness is prized in business communication. Keeping outreach emails under 150 to 200 words dramatically improves response rates and reader comprehension.

Word Count vs Character Count

Understanding the distinction between words and characters helps prevent formatting errors when submitting work to systems with rigid constraints:

Example sentence: "AI Free Calculator helps you."
  • Word Count: 5 words (each distinct group of letters separated by spaces).
  • Character Count (With Spaces): 29 characters (including letters, period, and spaces).
  • Characters Without Spaces: 25 characters (counting only visible letters and punctuation).

Short message services (SMS), ad copy headlines, and database fields generally track raw characters, whereas writing editors and book publishers focus primarily on total word count.

How Are Reading and Speaking Times Calculated?

Reading and speaking calculations translate numerical word volume into intuitive time commitments:

📖 Reading Time

Estimated using the formula: Word Count ÷ 225 WPM. Research across cognitive linguistics indicates that English-speaking adults read silently at an average speed of 200 to 250 words per minute. Technical, legal, or dense scientific copy may require more time, while casual fiction is read faster.

🎙️ Speaking Time

Estimated using the formula: Word Count ÷ 130 WPM. A conversational speaking pace for public presentations, voiceover narration, and podcasting averages between 120 and 150 words per minute. This benchmark provides comfortable breathing room for natural pauses and emphasis.

Is This Word Counter Free and Private?

Yes. Our word counter is completely free and operates with strict client-side privacy. When you paste your writing into the editor, the calculations take place exclusively in your device's memory using JavaScript.

No text is uploaded to any server, no analytics record your drafted paragraphs, and no cookies store your personal notes. When you close the browser tab or refresh the page, your entered text disappears completely from memory.

faqs.question: वर्ड काउंटर (Word Counter) क्या है?
faqs.answer: वर्ड काउंटर एक डिजिटल टूल है जो किसी लेख में शब्दों, वर्णों (अक्षरों), वाक्यों, पैराग्राफ और पढ़ने के समय की तुरंत गणना करता है।

faqs.question: क्या यह वर्ड काउंटर पूरी तरह मुफ्त है?
faqs.answer: हाँ, यह 100% मुफ्त है और बिना किसी सीमा या लॉगिन के इस्तेमाल किया जा सकता है।

faqs.question: शब्दों की गिनती कैसे की जाती है?
faqs.answer: यह रिक्त स्थान (स्पेस), विराम चिह्न और पैराग्राफ के आधार पर शब्दों को अलग करके सटीक गिनती करता है।

faqs.question: क्या यह अक्षरों (Characters) की गिनती करता है?
faqs.answer: हाँ, यह स्पेस सहित और स्पेस रहित अक्षरों की अलग-अलग गिनती दिखाता है।

faqs.question: क्या बिना स्पेस के अक्षरों की गिनती संभव है?
faqs.answer: हाँ, 'Characters (No Spaces)' विकल्प केवल दृश्य अक्षरों और अंकों को गिनता है।

faqs.question: क्या यह वाक्यों और पैराग्राफों को भी गिनता है?
faqs.answer: हाँ, पूर्ण विराम (. ! ?) के आधार पर वाक्यों और लाइन ब्रेक के आधार पर पैराग्राफों की गिनती की जाती है।

faqs.question: पढ़ने के समय (Reading Time) की गणना कैसे होती है?
faqs.answer: औसत वयस्क के पढ़ने की गति (लगभग 200-250 शब्द प्रति मिनट) के आधार पर समय का अनुमान लगाया जाता है।

faqs.question: बोलने के समय (Speaking Time) का अनुमान कैसे लगता है?
faqs.answer: भाषण या प्रस्तुति के लिए लगभग 130 शब्द प्रति मिनट की दर से समय निकाला जाता है।

faqs.question: क्या इसे निबंध और असाइनमेंट के लिए इस्तेमाल कर सकते हैं?
faqs.answer: हाँ, छात्र और लेखक अपने निबंधों और शोध पत्रों की शब्द सीमा जांचने के लिए इसका व्यापक उपयोग करते हैं।

faqs.question: क्या मेरा टेक्स्ट कहीं स्टोर होता है?
faqs.answer: नहीं, सारी गिनती 100% आपके डिवाइस में होती है और कोई भी टेक्स्ट सर्वर पर नहीं भेजा जाता।

faqs.question: क्या मेरा पेस्ट किया गया टेक्स्ट किसी बाहरी सर्वर पर भेजा जाता है?
faqs.answer: नहीं। पूरा विश्लेषण आपके ब्राउज़र के स्थानीय जावास्क्रिप्ट इंजन में होता है। आपका ड्राफ्ट कभी भी किसी सर्वर पर सेव नहीं होता।

faqs.question: पढ़ने के समय की गणना कैसे की जाती है?
faqs.answer: पढ़ने के समय की गणना कुल शब्द संख्या को 200 शब्द प्रति मिनट (वयस्कों की औसत पठन गति) से विभाजित करके की जाती है।

faqs.question: क्या यह टूल हिंदी और देवनागरी लिपि का सटीक विश्लेषण करता है?
faqs.answer: हाँ। यह टूल यूनिकोड अक्षरों और मात्राओं का सही मिलान करता है ताकि देवनागरी वर्णों की सही गिनती हो सके।

faqs.question: स्पेस के साथ और बिना स्पेस वर्णों की गिनती में क्या अंतर है?
faqs.answer: स्पेस सहित गिनती में रिक्त स्थान और नई लाइनें शामिल होती हैं (जो ट्विटर/सोशल मीडिया पर आवश्यक हैं), जबकि बिना स्पेस में केवल दृश्य वर्ण गिने जाते हैं।

faqs.answer: Se contabilizan las secuencias de caracteres separadas por espacios en blanco, saltos de línea o signos de puntuación estándar.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre caracteres con y sin espacios?
faqs.answer: El recuento total incluye los espacios en blanco entre vocablos, mientras que el recuento sin espacios mide únicamente las letras, números y signos gráficos.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo se calcula el tiempo de lectura?
faqs.answer: Se basa en una velocidad de lectura media estándar de 200 a 250 palabras por minuto en adultos.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo se calcula el tiempo estimado de locución?
faqs.answer: Se toma como referencia una cadencia de habla oral de 130 a 150 palabras por minuto.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la longitud ideal para publicaciones en redes sociales?
faqs.answer: Para Twitter/X son 280 caracteres; para posts de LinkedIn se recomiendan entre 1.000 y 2.000 caracteres; y para descripciones de Instagram, hasta 2.200 caracteres.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la extensión recomendada para un artículo de blog o SEO?
faqs.answer: Los artículos completos y competitivos suelen tener entre 1.500 y 2.500 palabras para abordar temas a profundidad.

faqs.question: ¿Qué es la densidad de palabras clave?
faqs.answer: Es el porcentaje que representa una palabra o frase clave respecto al total de términos del texto.

faqs.question: ¿Hay límite en la cantidad de texto que se puede analizar?
faqs.answer: No, puedes pegar documentos enteros, ensayos universitarios o manuscritos completos sin restricción.

faqs.question: ¿Queda registrado mi texto en algún lugar?
faqs.answer: No. El análisis se realiza localmente en la memoria de tu navegador garantizando total confidencialidad.

faqs.question: ¿Admite caracteres multilingües y acentos?
faqs.answer: Sí, admite caracteres UTF-8 completos, acentos, caracteres cirílicos, asiáticos y emojis.

faqs.question: ¿El texto ingresado se envía a servidores externos?
faqs.answer: No. El análisis se realiza completamente en el motor JavaScript de su navegador. Su texto nunca se envía ni se almacena externamente.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo se calcula el tiempo estimado de lectura?
faqs.answer: Se divide el número total de palabras entre 200 palabras por minuto, la velocidad promedio de comprensión en lectura para adultos.

faqs.question: ¿Soporta caracteres especiales y acentos en español?
faqs.answer: Sí. El motor de expresiones regulares contempla el conjunto completo de caracteres acentuados, eñes y signos de apertura (¿, ¡).

faqs.question: ¿Qué diferencia hay entre contar con o sin espacios?
faqs.answer: El recuento con espacios incluye separadores y saltos de línea (ideal para límites de redes sociales), mientras que sin espacios mide únicamente los caracteres visibles.

faqs.question: 文字数カウント（Word Counter）とは何ですか？
faqs.answer: テキストの文字数、単語数、空白の有無による文字数、段落数、読了予想時間をリアルタイムで計測するツールです。

faqs.question: 単語数はどのようにカウントされますか？
faqs.answer: 英単語はスペースで区切られた単位で、日本語や中国語などの文字は形態素や文字単位で正確に計測されます。

faqs.question: 「空白あり」と「空白なし」の違いは何ですか？
faqs.answer: 「空白あり」はスペースや改行を含めた総文字数で、「空白なし」は純粋な文章記号と文字のみを数えた数値です。

faqs.question: 読了時間（読むのにかかる時間）はどう計算されますか？
faqs.answer: 大人の平均的な読書速度（1分あたり400〜600文字、英語なら約200〜250単語）を基準に算出しています。

faqs.question: スピーチや朗読の所要時間はどう計算されますか？
faqs.answer: 標準的なアナウンサーの音声速度（1分あたり約300〜350文字）を目安に計算されます。

faqs.question: 主要SNSの文字数目安はどれくらいですか？
faqs.answer: X（旧Twitter）は全角140文字（半角280文字）、Instagramのキャプションは最大2,200文字が上限です。

faqs.question: SEO記事やブログ記事の理想的な文字数は？
faqs.answer: 検索エンジンで上位表示を狙う専門性の高い解説記事では、2,000〜4,000文字以上が推奨されます。

faqs.question: キーワード出現頻度（密度）とは何ですか？
faqs.answer: 文章全体の中で特定の単語が占める出現割合（パーセンテージ）のことです。

faqs.question: 文字数の入力上限はありますか？
faqs.answer: 制限はありません。長文レポート、卒論、小説の全章などを貼り付けて測定可能です。

faqs.question: 入力した文章が外部に保存されることはありますか？
faqs.answer: ありません。すべての解析はお使いのブラウザ内部で行われ、サーバーに送信されません。

faqs.question: ひらがな、カタカナ、漢字、絵文字に対応していますか？
faqs.answer: はい。全角文字、半角文字、各種記号およびUnicode絵文字に完全対応しています。

faqs.question: 貼り付けたテキストが外部サーバーに送信・保存されることはありますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ。すべてのテキスト解析はお使いのブラウザ内部で完結します。機密文書や未公開の下書きも安全にカウントできます。

faqs.question: 読了時間の計算基準は何ですか？
faqs.answer: 一般的な日本語の読書速度（1分あたり約500文字）および英単語（分速200語）を基準に推定時間を算出しています。

faqs.question: 日本語（漢字・ひらがな・カタカナ）の文字数は正しく認識されますか？
faqs.answer: はい。Unicode文字プロパティに対応した正規表現を採用しており、日本語の約物や全角文字も正確に集計されます。

faqs.question: 空白込みと空白除外の違いは何ですか？
faqs.answer: 空白込みはスペースや改行文字を含めた総文字数（SNS等の投稿制限用）、空白除外は純粋な文章構成文字のみを指します。

faqs.question: Qu'est-ce qu'un compteur de mots ?
faqs.answer: C'est un outil qui analyse en temps réel le nombre de mots, de caractères (avec et sans espaces), de phrases, de paragraphes et le temps de lecture estimé.

faqs.question: Comment les mots sont-ils comptabilisés ?
faqs.answer: Les mots sont identifiés par les séparateurs usuels tels que les espaces, retours à la ligne et ponctuations.

faqs.question: Quelle est la différence entre caractères avec et sans espaces ?
faqs.answer: Le total avec espaces intègre les blancs typographiques, tandis que le décompte sans espaces ne retient que les symboles et lettres.

faqs.question: Comment est calculé le temps de lecture ?
faqs.answer: Le calcul se base sur une vitesse moyenne de lecture silencieuse de 200 à 250 mots par minute chez l'adulte.

faqs.question: Comment est estimé le temps d'élocution à voix haute ?
faqs.answer: L'estimation repose sur un débit moyen de prise de parole en public de 130 à 150 mots par minute.

faqs.question: Quelle est la longueur idéale pour les réseaux sociaux ?
faqs.answer: 280 caractères pour X (Twitter), environ 1 000 à 2 000 caractères pour LinkedIn et jusqu'à 2 200 pour Instagram.

faqs.question: Quelle longueur viser pour un article de blog SEO ?
faqs.answer: Un article de référence se situe généralement entre 1 500 et 2 500 mots pour bien se positionner sur les moteurs de recherche.

faqs.question: Qu'est-ce que la densité des mots-clés ?
faqs.answer: C'est la fréquence relative d'un mot par rapport au volume total de termes présents dans le contenu.

faqs.question: Y a-t-il une limite de volume de texte ?
faqs.answer: Aucune limite : vous pouvez analyser de longs rapports, des mémoires ou des ouvrages entiers.

faqs.question: Mon texte est-il confidentiel ?
faqs.answer: Absolument. Aucune phrase n'est transmise sur Internet, l'analyse reste confinée à votre navigateur.

faqs.question: Gère-t-il les caractères accentués et alphabets non-latins ?
faqs.answer: Oui, prise en charge intégrale de la norme UTF-8, des accents et des caractères internationaux.

faqs.question: Le texte saisi est-il conservé sur un serveur ?
faqs.answer: Non. Le comptage est exécuté exclusivement dans la mémoire de votre navigateur. Vos textes demeurent strictement confidentiels.

faqs.question: Comment le temps de lecture est-il déterminé ?
faqs.answer: Il est calculé en divisant le nombre total de mots par 200 mots par minute, référence courante pour la lecture adulte.

faqs.question: Les caractères accentués français sont-ils bien comptabilisés ?
faqs.answer: Oui. Le parseur gère l'ensemble de l'alphabet latin étendu, y compris les accents (é, è, ê) et les cédilles.

faqs.question: Pourquoi distinguer les caractères avec et sans espaces ?
faqs.answer: Le décompte avec espaces sert aux limites strictes de publication (réseaux sociaux), tandis que sans espaces sert aux métriques de traduction.

faqs.question: Was ist ein Wortzähler (Word Counter)?
faqs.answer: Ein Werkzeug zur Echtzeit-Erfassung von Wörtern, Zeichen (mit/ohne Leerzeichen), Sätzen, Absätzen und Lesezeiten.

faqs.question: Wie werden Wörter gezählt?
faqs.answer: Wörter werden anhand von Leerzeichen, Zeilenumbrüchen und Interpunktionsregeln segmentiert und ermittelt.

faqs.question: Was ist der Unterschied zwischen Zeichen mit und ohne Leerzeichen?
faqs.answer: Zeichen mit Leerzeichen zählen alle Anschläge inklusive Zwischenräume; ohne Leerzeichen werden nur gedruckte Buchstaben und Ziffern erfasst.

faqs.question: Wie wird die Lesezeit berechnet?
faqs.answer: Grundlage ist eine durchschnittliche Lesegeschwindigkeit von 200 bis 250 Wörtern pro Minute.

faqs.question: Wie wird die Sprechzeit ermittelt?
faqs.answer: Für gesprochene Vorträge und Podcasts wird eine Rate von 130 bis 150 Wörtern pro Minute zugrunde gelegt.

faqs.question: Welche Textlängen gelten für soziale Netzwerke?
faqs.answer: 280 Zeichen für X/Twitter, 1.000 bis 2.000 Zeichen für LinkedIn-Posts und bis zu 2.200 für Instagram-Beiträge.

faqs.question: Welche Wortanzahl ist ideal für SEO-Artikel?
faqs.answer: Umfassende Blogbeiträge mit starker Suchmaschinenrelevanz umfassen typischerweise 1.500 bis 2.500 Wörter.

faqs.question: Was versteht man unter Keyword-Dichte?
faqs.answer: Der prozentuale Anteil, den ein bestimmter Suchbegriff an der Gesamtwortzahl des Textes ausmacht.

faqs.question: Gibt es eine Obergrenze für Textmengen?
faqs.answer: Nein, Sie können beliebig lange Abhandlungen, Bachelorarbeiten oder Buchkapitel einfügen.

faqs.question: Bleiben meine Texte geschützt?
faqs.answer: Ja, die Textprüfung erfolgt rein lokal im Arbeitsspeicher Ihres Browsers ohne Serverübertragung.

faqs.question: Werden Umlaute und Sonderzeichen korrekt erfasst?
faqs.answer: Ja, vollständige Unterstützung für deutsche Umlaute (ä, ö, ü, ß) und globale Zeichensätze.

faqs.question: Wird der eingegebene Text auf Server übertragen?
faqs.answer: Nein. Die Analyse findet zu 100 % lokal im Browser statt. Ihr Text wird zu keinem Zeitpunkt übertragen oder gespeichert.

faqs.question: Werden deutsche Umlaute und Sonderzeichen korrekt gezählt?
faqs.answer: Ja. Umlaute (ä, ö, ü) und das Eszett (ß) werden durch vollständige Unicode-Unterstützung präzise erfasst.

faqs.question: Como as palavras são contabilizadas?
faqs.answer: Identificam-se as palavras a partir de espaços em branco, quebras de parágrafo e divisores de pontuação.

faqs.question: Qual a diferença entre caracteres com e sem espaços?
faqs.answer: Com espaços inclui todos os toques no teclado; sem espaços considera apenas letras, numerais e símbolos gráficos.

faqs.question: Como é calculado o tempo de leitura?
faqs.answer: Utiliza-se a velocidade média de leitura silenciosa de 200 a 250 palavras por minuto.

faqs.question: Como é estimado o tempo de fala?
faqs.answer: Calcula-se com base na velocidade média de oratória de 130 a 150 palavras por minuto.

faqs.question: Qual o tamanho ideal para redes sociais?
faqs.answer: 280 caracteres no X/Twitter, entre 1.000 e 2.000 caracteres no LinkedIn e até 2.200 no Instagram.

faqs.question: Quantas palavras deve ter um artigo de blog para SEO?
faqs.answer: Artigos aprofundados e de boa colocação no Google costumam ter entre 1.500 e 2.500 palavras.

faqs.question: O que significa densidade de palavras-chave?
faqs.answer: É a porcentagem que um termo representa em relação ao volume total de vocábulos do texto.

faqs.question: Existe limite de tamanho de texto?
faqs.answer: Não há limites. Pode colar artigos extensos, monografias ou livros inteiros.

faqs.question: Meu texto fica gravado em algum lugar?
faqs.answer: Não. A contagem funciona estritamente no seu navegador garantindo sigilo absoluto.

faqs.question: Suporta acentos e pontuação em português?
faqs.answer: Sim, suporte completo a acentuação gráfica, cedilha e caracteres UTF-8.

faqs.question: O texto digitado é transferido para algum servidor?
faqs.answer: Não. Toda a contagem roda no motor JavaScript do seu próprio navegador. Seus rascunhos nunca saem do seu aparelho.

faqs.question: O contador reconhece acentuação em português?
faqs.answer: Sim. Todas as palavras acentuadas e caracteres especiais como "ç" e "ã" são interpretados com total precisão.

faqs.question: Qual a utilidade da contagem sem espaços?
faqs.answer: A contagem sem espaços é exigida por agências de tradução e revisores, enquanto a contagem com espaços é padrão em formulários e redes sociais.

faqs.question: 단어 수는 어떻게 측정되나요?

faqs.question: 공백 포함과 공백 제외의 차이점은?

faqs.question: 예상 독서 시간은 어떻게 계산되나요?

faqs.question: 발표 및 스피치 소요 시간 계산 기준은?
faqs.answer: 일반적인 프레젠테이션 및 발표 발화 속도(분당 300~350자)를 기준으로 소요 시간을 추정합니다.

faqs.question: SNS 플랫폼별 권장 글자 수는?

faqs.question: 자기소개서 작성 시 공백 포함/제외 중 어느 것을 보나요?

faqs.question: 키워드 밀도(Keyword Density)란 무엇인가요?
faqs.answer: 전체 텍스트에서 특정 단어가 차지하는 출현 비율을 뜻합니다.

faqs.question: 텍스트 입력량에 제한이 있나요?

faqs.question: 내가 입력한 글이 서버에 저장되나요?

faqs.question: 한글 맞춤법, 특수문자, 이모지도 지원되나요?

faqs.question: 입력한 텍스트가 외부 서버에 전송되거나 저장되나요?
faqs.answer: 아닙니다. 모든 텍스트 연산은 브라우저 로컬 자바스크립트 엔진 내에서 수행되므로 기밀 문서도 안전하게 검토할 수 있습니다.

faqs.question: 읽기 시간 산출 기준은 무엇인가요?

faqs.question: 한글의 자모 및 띄어쓰기가 정확하게 카운트되나요?

faqs.question: 공백 포함과 공백 제외 글자 수의 차이는 무엇인가요?
faqs.answer: 공백 포함은 띄어쓰기와 줄바꿈을 모두 합산한 수치(이력서/자기소개서 규격용)이며, 공백 제외는 순수 활자 글자 수만을 의미합니다.

faqs.question: Qual è la differenza tra caratteri con o senza spazi?

faqs.question: Come viene calcolato il tempo di lettura?

faqs.question: Come si calcola il tempo di lettura a voce alta?

faqs.question: Qual è la lunghezza ottimale per i social network?

faqs.question: Quante parole deve contenere un testo per la SEO?

faqs.question: Cosa si intende per densità delle parole chiave?
faqs.answer: La percentuale di occorrenza di un vocabolo rispetto al totale delle parole presenti nel documento.

faqs.question: C'è un limite al numero di parole analizzabili?
faqs.answer: Nessun limite: puoi incollare saggi accademici, tesi o interi manoscritti.

faqs.question: Il mio testo viene registrato o salvato?

faqs.question: Supporta caratteri accentati ed emoji?

faqs.question: Il testo inserito viene inviato a server esterni?

faqs.question: Come viene calcolato il tempo di lettura stimato?

faqs.question: Le lettere accentate italiane sono conteggiate correttamente?
faqs.answer: Sì. La tokenizzazione Unicode include tutte le vocali accentate e i caratteri speciali della lingua italiana.

faqs.question: A cosa serve il conteggio senza spazi?
